known_issues: Reports tab error: 'Report for 3 months' and 'Print report 6 months' do not allow choosing the desired contiguous 3- or 6-month range (should work like monthly report selection).

existing_features.title: Update the Reports page so that when Report Type is set to "3 Months", the user can select a specific contiguous 3-month range (similar to the existing Monthly month/year selector) instead of using a single "Reference Date" date picker.

Update the Reports page so that when Report Type is set to "6 Months", the user can select a specific contiguous 6-month range (similar to the existing Monthly month/year selector) instead of using a single "Reference Date" date picker.

Ensure report date-range calculation logic in the Reports page is consistent across Monthly, 3 Months, and 6 Months selections (full-month windows) and does not rely on arbitrary day-based reference dates for multi-month report types.

new_feature_requests.summary: Reports tab: allow selecting a specific contiguous 3-month date range for the 'Report for 3 months' option (like monthly report selection)
Reports tab: allow selecting a specific contiguous 6-month date range for the 'Print report 6 months' option

projectName: Reports tab: allow selecting contiguous 3-month and 6-month report ranges
